title: "Xi-Fangeda"
format: html
---
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(gganimate)
library(janitor)
library(cluster)

library(rnaturalearth)
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

data_2000 <- democracy_data |>
  filter(year == 2000)

world_data <- world |>
  left_join(data_2000, by = c("name" = "country_name"))

ggplot(world_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill =is_democracy)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(title = "Democracy Scores in 2000")
```
